quotes: "Everyone experiences stress to some degree. You are not alone."
"Every day is a new chance to start again."
"We need patience — take it slow and steady."

welcome.sub:
PeaceFlow walks with you — gently, without judgment, one step at a time.
It only takes 2 minutes to start.

auth.title: Create your account
auth.subtitle: Choose how you'd like to sign up — quick and secure
auth.tryAnonNote: Want to try first? You can try anonymously — data stays on your device, sign up later.
auth.encryptedNote: Data is AES-256 encrypted. Only you have access. We never sell your data to third parties.

profileStep.title: What should I call you?
profileStep.subtitle: Just a few quick questions to get to know you!
profileStep.ageLabel: Which age group are you in?

reasons.understandSelf: I want to understand myself better
reasons.curious: I'm curious to try it out

mindset.title: Let's walk this path the right way
mindset.subtitle: Before we begin, let's go through 4 small principles together. Tap each card to flip and read more — like turning a page in a journal 📖

aiSupport.title: AI only supports — it doesn't replace people
aiSupport.description: PeaceFlow is a virtual companion — not a doctor, it doesn't diagnose conditions or prescribe medication. When you need deeper support, please connect with a real expert.

release.title: Don't suppress emotions — release them
release.description: Every emotion has value — including sadness, anger, or fear. Instead of suppressing them, recognize and release them through positive actions. Emotions aren't the enemy.

selfHelp.title: Only you can truly help yourself
selfHelp.description: PeaceFlow creates the environment and tools, but the real strength comes from you. Every small step you take is your own victory. We're just here to cheer you on! 🎉

patience.title: Patience — slow and steady
patience.description: Change doesn't happen overnight. It's okay if you miss a task some days — we don't punish, only reward. Go at your own pace. 🌿

device.title: Connect a smart device
device.subtitle: Sync your watch so PeaceFlow can understand you more accurately. Totally skippable!

complete.desc:
Your journey has officially begun!
PeaceFlow will always be here, walking with you every day. 💚
complete.warningNote: ⚠️ Note: This app is a support tool, not a substitute for medical diagnosis. If you're in an emergency: 📞 0931773637 (Free, 24/7)
